# SolidCraft 0.42.0 reference snapshot

This directory is a local, version-pinned reference for Forge qualification.

- SolidCraft release: `v0.42.0`
- Upstream repository: `tangency-labs/solidcraft`
- Upstream commit: `1b1e940cc48e4d1d5d01971a4be20e2e55647066`
- Snapshot source: `docs/features.md`
- Snapshot file: `commands.md`

The upstream file is generated by SolidCraft itself from its command registry
(`cargo xtask features`; the same registry is exposed by
`solidcraft-cli commands`). Keep this snapshot unchanged so it remains useful
as version-specific evidence.

For normal Forge work, do **not** read this entire file first. Start with
`docs/agent/solidcraft.md`, which contains only the Forge-relevant subset and
points here when the full catalog is needed.

For exact input/output schemas, prefer local runtime introspection against the
pinned executable rather than an external website:

```text
solidcraft-cli commands
solidcraft-cli exec engine.describe '{"command":"solid.box"}'
```

When Forge moves to another qualified SolidCraft version, add a new sibling
directory. Do not overwrite this 0.42.0 snapshot.
